findings.title: Migration crashes when no configured embed category exists
findings.body: The query result is indexed unconditionally with `[0]['id']`. On installations where `embed_category` is still its default/blank value (or no site_settings row exists for it), the join produces no rows and `[0]` is nil, raising `NoMethodError` before the fallback to `uncategorized_category_id` can run. This makes the migration fail for the normal configuration it is supposed to migrate.

findings.title: Legacy host entries are inserted without normalization and stop matching requests
findings.body: The migration inserts old `embeddable_hosts` values through raw SQL, bypassing EmbeddableHost's `before_validation` normalization. The previous setting accepted entries such as `http://discourse.org` and `https://example.com/1234` (and existing tests cover those forms), but the new lookup compares `URI(referer).host` (for example, `discourse.org`) against the stored host string. Consequently those migrated hosts no longer authorize embeds or retrievals after upgrade. Normalize each legacy value before insertion (and safely quote/bind it) so the persisted value is just the hostname.

findings.title: Blank host submissions raise instead of producing a validation error
findings.body: The validation callback unconditionally calls `self.host.sub!`, so creating an EmbeddableHost with a missing host causes `undefined method sub! for nil:NilClass`. This is reachable through the new admin create API by submitting an empty `embeddable_host` payload, yielding a 500 rather than the model's normal invalid-record response. Guard the normalization for nil/blank values and add a presence validation.

findings.title: Update and delete nonexistent hosts return server errors
findings.body: Both `update` and `destroy` use `where(...).first` and immediately dereference the result. For an unknown ID, update passes nil to `save_host` and destroy calls `nil.destroy`, producing a 500 response instead of a 404. The admin client or any API caller can encounter this after a concurrent deletion; use `find_by` with an explicit not-found response (or `find`) before operating on the record.

findings.title: Valid modern domain names cannot be added as embeddable hosts
findings.body: The hostname validation limits the final label to 2 through 5 characters. Valid domains with longer TLDs, such as `example.museum`, `example.travel`, or `example.technology`, are rejected by the new admin UI/API and therefore cannot be configured for embedding. The previous host-list behavior did not impose this TLD-length restriction; use URI/hostname validation that permits valid TLD lengths.
